thesis: The speakers argue that building a technology company in Latin America involves solving unique challenges such as fragmented financial infrastructure, limited access to credit, and underdeveloped software systems. Adi addresses these issues by evolving from a buy-now-pay-later product into a broader platform offering payments, commerce, logistics, and banking to serve over three million consumers and 50,000 merchant partners.
